summary.text: Drew Cox, a Democratic Marine Corps veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Indiana's 4th Congressional District to Jim Baird.
He used the GI Bill to earn a doctorate in music and serves as a Visiting Instructor at Purdue University and as a percussionist with Lafayette ensembles.

paragraphs.text: Cox describes himself as a lifelong Hoosier, the son of an elementary school teacher with 35 years of service and a fourth-generation farmer.

He served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2008 to 2012 and was honorably discharged in 2012. He used the GI Bill to attend Indiana University, then earned a doctorate in music from the University of Illinois and an associate degree in energy technology from Ivy Tech Community College.

Cox serves as a Visiting Instructor at Purdue University. He performs as a percussionist with the Lafayette Symphony Orchestra and the Lafayette Citizens Band, and is a member of the Marine Corps League and American Legion Post 11.
Cox won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary in a field of eight candidates with 30.4% of the vote. He challenged Republican Rep. Jim Baird, the incumbent in the 4th District.
He received 45.8% of the vote to Jim Baird's 54.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
